# Bundled libraries

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `echarts-5.6.0.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.6.0/dist/echarts.min.js (sha256 `bf4a223524e40b77c304bec67e1222cf551f14880cf42c69dc046558e11c07b1`) | Apache-2.0 |

Bundled in the image so the UI works without Internet access (isolated NAS).
The version number is part of the file name, which is served with `Cache-Control: immutable`.
